record.name: Fig - AI Agents & Automation
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Fig is the AI agent that works for you, right from your phone or tablet.

Tell it what you need in plain language. Fig researches, creates, and executes, then delivers the results. Reports, slide decks, websites, videos, podcasts, custom agents, and more. No learning curve. Just describe it.

Start with free daily credits, no commitment required.


Your Personal AI Agent

Fig doesn't just answer questions, it takes action:

• Research any topic and deliver cited reports
• Generate slide decks, videos, music, and podcasts
• Build websites and web apps from a description
• Create and run your own custom AI agents
• Connect your tools and automate recurring work
• Talk to Fig hands-free with the voice agent


Build Your Own Agents

Create custom AI agents for any job, each with its own instructions, tools, knowledge, and memory. Share them with your workspace, or set them to run automatically and deliver results to Slack, Telegram, or WhatsApp.


Research & Reports

Ask Fig to research anything: competitors, markets, trends, or technical topics. It pulls from live sources and delivers a formatted report you can share or export.


Slides & Presentations

Describe the deck you need. Fig generates professional slides with structure, visuals, and key points, ready to present or customize.


Video, Music & Podcasts

Turn ideas into media. Generate and edit videos, compose music, and create studio-style podcasts from your own sources, links, or documents.


AI Website Builder

Create professional websites from a simple description, with lead capture, analytics, and custom domains you can buy and connect in-app. Tap any element to edit it, and roll back to earlier versions anytime.


Talk to Fig

Have a natural voice conversation and Fig executes as you speak. Share your screen or camera live so it can see what you see and help in the moment.


Connect Your Tools

Link the apps you already use, including Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar, Notion, Slack, Figma, and Canva. Fig works across them to get things done.


Scheduled & Automated Tasks

Set it and forget it. Fig runs tasks on a schedule: daily briefings, weekly reports, monitoring, and more. Your agents keep working even when you're away.


Sharable Chats

Turn any conversation into a shared resource. Generate a link to share your chat, including all outputs, reports, and files.


Choose Your Model

Pick the AI that fits the task. Choose from leading models by OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Grok, and more.


AI Creative Studio

• Generate images from text prompts
• Edit photos with AI-powered tools
• Design logos with one tap
• Create templates and graphics for any project


Built For Everyone

Fig is for anyone with an idea:

• Entrepreneurs launching a product or service
• Freelancers building a portfolio or pitching clients
• Students creating study aids and research reports
• Creators producing videos, podcasts, and graphics
• Small business owners managing sites and content
• Teams sharing agents and collaborating via chat


One Agent. Unlimited Capabilities.

One conversation. Fig understands what you need and handles it, from building a website to producing a video to running your own custom agents. Just describe what you want.

Start creating for free. Upgrade anytime for more credits and premium features.

Unlimited AI image generation — on your device, not in the cloud.

LocalGen lets you create stunning AI images directly on your iPhone or iPad with no daily limits on supported hardware. No accounts, no queues, no tokens – just open the app and start generating. Unlimited playground for your wildest ideas.

Create with AI
• Turn text into images for art, logos, icons, posters and wallpapers
• Generate concept art and illustrations for games, books and design
• Create characters and portraits.
• Save images to Photos or share straight from your device


On-device, private by design
• Runs advanced stable diffusion models locally on your chip for low-latency generation
• Prompts and images never leave your device – no external servers
• Works even offline after download


Device compatibility & performance
For the best experience we recommend an A14-class chip or newer:
• Recommended chips: A14 Bionic, M1 or newer Apple Silicon
• Supported devices:
– iPhone 12 or newer
– iPad (10th gen or newer)
– iPad Air (4th gen or newer)
– Any iPad model released after 2022
• Not supported:
– iPhone 11 or earlier
– iPad (9th gen or earlier)
– iPad Air (3rd gen or earlier)
– Studio Display (2022)
– Any iPad model released before 2020


Support & Contact
Questions or feedback? Email us at contact@aina.tech

Instant Transformation:

Diverse Style Selection:

Comprehensive Library:
Stay ahead of the curve with our extensive library of interior design trends and inspirations. Whether you’re looking for the latest styles or classic touches, our app has you covered.

Why AI House Remodel?
Effortless Transformation: Easily visualize and plan your interior design projects with our intuitive interface.
Personalization: Personalize every aspect of your interior design to match your unique style and preferences.
Latest Trends: Stay updated with the latest trends and design ideas.
User-Friendly: Enjoy a seamless and user-friendly experience, making home design accessible to everyone.
Get Started Today
Download AI House Remodel now and unlock a world of interior design possibilities at your fingertips. Redefine your spaces, reimagine your style, and create the home of your dreams with ease. Whether you’re looking to refresh a single room or embark on a complete home makeover, our AI-powered features will streamline the process and ignite your creative spark.

Transform your home today with AI House Remodel – where every space becomes a canvas for innovation and style.

opchat lets you chat with all major AI models in one place — using your own API keys or running models directly on your device. Your API keys stay on your device, encrypted with secure storage. No middleman, no subscriptions, no data harvesting.

BRING YOUR OWN KEYS
Connect OpenAI (GPT), Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini), DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Straico, Azure, Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Switch between models mid-conversation or set a default per persona.

ON-DEVICE MODELS
Run AI models directly on your device — completely offline, no API key needed. Browse and download GGUF models from Hugging Face. Your data never leaves your phone. Perfect for privacy-sensitive use or when you're offline.

CUSTOM PERSONAS
Create AI assistants tailored to your needs. Set a system prompt, personality, speaking style, knowledge areas, and conversation starters. Build a research analyst, a coding mentor, a creative writing partner — whatever you need.

BUILT-IN TOOLS
• Web Search — real-time results via Serper or Tavily
• Image Generation & Editing — create and refine images with AI
• Voice — speech-to-text input and text-to-speech output
• Memory — the AI remembers context across your conversations
• MCP Servers — extend with custom tools via Model Context Protocol

ORGANIZE YOUR WORK
Group conversations into projects. Pin important chats. Search across all your history. Export conversations as Markdown or JSON.

FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE
Choose from multiple themes (Claude, GPT, Perplexity, Code) or create your own with custom colors. Pick from 23 fonts. Adjust message density, roundness, and font size.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Zero tracking. Zero analytics. Your API keys are encrypted on-device. Conversations go directly to your chosen AI provider — we never see them. Use on-device models or Ollama for fully offline, local AI with no data leaving your phone.

AI-GENERATED CONTENT
All responses are generated by third-party AI models and may be inaccurate or incomplete. Content safety is enforced by each provider's built-in policies. You can report any AI-generated response directly within the app.

record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
DDchat AI is a polished, minimalist native iOS AI client with web search, multimodal understanding, and HTML rendering. Connect your own APIs to use different providers and models in one flexible, fluid app.

— BEAUTIFUL BY DESIGN —
From rounded bubbles to smooth streaming animations, from live scrolling reasoning previews to syntax-highlighted code blocks, every pixel is polished. Full Light and Dark Mode support, liquid glass, and gradient accents create a truly native experience.

— OFFICIAL APIs AND THIRD-PARTY GATEWAYS —
One app to connect with advanced AI models from around the world. Use DeepSeek, Kimi, MiniMax, Zhipu, MiMo, Qwen, and more. Connect to official providers or compatible third-party gateways, choose your provider, and switch models to suit each task.

— AUTOMATIC MODEL CAPABILITY DETECTION —
A built-in capability database detects whether a model supports advanced reasoning, vision, tool calling, and more, then applies the appropriate parameters. The database updates silently from the cloud, helping new models work without an app update.

— HTML RENDERING ENGINE —
HTML tags in AI replies can be rendered directly in the conversation, making cards, tables, lists, and other rich content easier to read. Built-in Markdown parsing and syntax highlighting for 10+ languages, including Python, Swift, Go, and Rust, keep code and quotes clear as well.

— MATH AND DIAGRAM RENDERING —
Render LaTeX equations and Mermaid diagrams right in your conversations, from formulas to flowcharts and sequence diagrams. Zoom in on diagrams and save them as images for study, organization, or sharing.

— WEB SEARCH WITH SOURCES —
Use built-in model search or connect a range of independent search services. Models can search and browse the web based on your question, with citations and sources shown directly in the answer so important information is easy to verify.

— MULTIMODAL IMAGE UNDERSTANDING —
Take a photo or select multiple images from your library and chat directly with vision-capable models. Analyze screenshots, understand scenes, or read text from images with ease.

— VISUALIZED REASONING —
See a model's reasoning as it is generated, then expand it for more detail. When supported, choose different reasoning levels to balance response speed and depth.

— TASK-SPECIFIC ASSISTANTS —
Create dedicated AI assistants for different scenarios, such as translation, coding, writing, or research. Each assistant has its own system prompt, sampling parameters, context length, and default model.

— ASSISTANT CREATION AND OPTIMIZATION TOOLS —
Describe what you need in one sentence, and AI can create a new assistant for you. If the results are not quite right, use another request to refine its prompts and related settings so it works the way you want.

— PRIVACY-FIRST, STORED LOCALLY —
API keys, chats, and assistant settings are stored locally on your device. Requests go directly to the AI provider you choose, without passing through a DDchat intermediary server. No analytics, no ads, no tracking.

— MORE HIGHLIGHTS —
- Multi-conversation history grouped by assistant
- Fetch model lists online or add models manually
- Duplicate, import, and share assistants
- Keep streaming replies running in the background and generate with multiple assistants at once

Getting started:
1. Add an API provider in Settings, either an official endpoint or a compatible gateway
2. Create an AI assistant and configure its prompt and parameters
3. Choose a model and start chatting

Note: This app requires you to provide your own API keys. It does not include or provide any AI service.

— CONTACT —
For feedback or questions, please email: ddchatsupport@gmail.com

Poly-Glot AI Workspace — ASK any question. COMPARE answers from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, Mistral, DuckDuckGo AI, and HuggingChat — all from one prompt. Every Language. One Prompt. Every AI — Compare the Results.

The 3-day full-access trial starts with the first qualifying Send and does not automatically become a paid subscription. Afterward, 25 free templates and one shared single-AI Send every rolling 24 hours remain free. Pro unlocks unlimited Sends, premium templates and Compare Mode.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Ask Any AI: type or speak in any of 38 languages.
2. Choose from 1,000+ templates across 40+ categories, or create your own prompt.
3. Type, paste, import, scan, or dictate your content.
4. Choose your AI Output Language to request a response in that language.
5. Tap Send and choose an AI, or enable Compare Mode to select several.
6. Poly-Glot copies your prompt. In the AI app, tap to paste prompt and send.
7. Repeat for other selected AIs, compare their responses, and choose the strongest result.

COMPARE MODE
Use one prompt across multiple AI apps. Choose providers, tap Send to All, and open each AI in turn. Your prompt is copied to the clipboard for manual pasting; AI responses remain in the provider's app. Compare their answers and pick the strongest. Included during the trial; a Pro subscription is required afterward.

ChatGPT· Claude· Gemini· Grok· Perplexity· Mistral· DuckDuckGo AI· HuggingChat

1,000+ TEMPLATES
Business, Coding, Writing, Education, Marketing, Legal, Health, Finance, Real Estate, and 30+ more categories. Each template has smart fields with placeholder hints. 25 free templates always available. 900+ Pro templates with subscription.

• 3-day free trial (full access to everything)• The 3-day full-access trial starts with the first qualifying Send and does not automatically become a paid subscription. Events include platform, trial/Pro status and a random app-install identifier, but never prompt text, AI responses, names, Apple account IDs, payment details or session recordings. PostHog may process IP addresses during delivery. You can turn analytics off at any time in Settings to stop new events and erase the local identifier. Contact us to request access or deletion.

record.description_evidence:
Write a quick draft, understand a difficult topic or current events, or plan your next trip - without juggling apps.
Get AI chat, web research, document analysis, and image creation in one place.
MakeNess AI helps you turn everyday questions into answers you can use.



ONE AI ASSISTANT, MANY EVERYDAY TASKS
Draft emails or contract, translate text just take picture of it if you want, brainstorm ideas you will get more exploration suggestions, refine your CV, or get understand current events around you.
Geppetto, the default AI, chooses the best AI model for you and optimizes your request.
You can still choose your preferred AI from the best in the world, across continents.
Shift from a brief inquiry to detailed, advanced interactive responses that use varied tailored visuals for rapid comprehension and quizzes to confirm understanding.
All without requiring a login, to keep things privite and stored on your device.


CREATE IMAGES AND EDIT VIDEOS
Turn ideas into AI images, illustrations, social media visuals, and even video clips directly in chat.
Refine images with text instructions or transform it to video using a prompt.
Attached media keeps its original aspect ratio during generation, so your creations fit the format you started with.


PLAN WITH CURRENT INFORMATION
Compare travel destinations, research accommodation options, or weigh a purchase against your budget and priorities.
Response may include a personalized engine that conducts multi-step web research on your device, compares options against your constraints, and assists you in interpreting the results.


STUDY FROM YOUR OWN MATERIALS
We have optimised Geppeto to help you upgrade your knowlege quickly, to acheive your life goals.
You receive tailored teaching responses that include graphs, schemas, images, YouTube clips, or quizzes to validate your understanding.
Take photo and ask to summarize lecture notes, compare concepts, or request a clearer explanation of a difficult passage.
We provide a shortcut you can connect to an action button in settings; with one click, you can capture what appears on your phone and embed it in a new conversation to raise questions.
Whether you are reviewing anatomy for an exam, preparing a class presentation, or exploring the new solution to the Navier–Stokes Mellinian problem, bring your hunger to learn into the discussion.
Native tables, diagrams, and mathematical notation make detailed answers easier to read.


KEEP PERSONAL FILES LOCAL
Your documents are indexed on your device, without uploading the files to the server.
Before sharing a picture with an AI model, use Photo Studio to crop, annotate, or redact sensitive faces and text locally.
Keep control over what leaves your device.


ORGANIZE IDEAS WITHOUT LOSING YOUR PLACE
Explore a different approach by branching a conversation.
Search across entire threads, including every branch, and jump straight to matching messages.
Automatically named chats help keep work, study, travel plans, and creative projects easy to find.


SAVE ANSWERS WORTH KEEPING
Export conversations as carefully typeset PDFs with embedded visuals, or capture every branch in one document.
Copy long answers as a single stitched image for easy sharing.
Subscribers can remove or personalize watermarks on shared images, videos, and PDFs.


BUILT FOR YOUR DAILY ROUTINE
Use MakeNess AI as a writing assistant, study companion, research tool, trip planner, or creative workspace.
Scalable interface elements adapt to your system settings, while rich formatting keeps complex information readable on smaller screens.



Start with free models, with subscription options for premium models and advanced features.

Download MakeNess AI and bring your questions, files, plans, and creative ideas together.

record.description_evidence:
Identify construction materials instantly with the power of AI. Whether you are working on a restoration, a building project, or simply curious about the materials around you, this app gives you fast and reliable answers in seconds.

Just take a photo and the app will analyze it to provide accurate details, helping you save time and make smarter decisions.

Who is it for?

Builders & Contractors – Quickly confirm material types on-site.

DIY Enthusiasts – Gain confidence in your projects with reliable material recognition.

Architects & Designers – Ensure the right materials are used for planning and reference.

Students & Learners – Study material science in a simple and interactive way.

Key Features

AI-Powered Recognition – Take a photo and get instant results.

Detailed Material Information – Learn about composition, usage, and characteristics.

Simple & Fast – No complicated steps, just point and scan.

Works Anywhere – Use the app at home, in the workshop, or on-site.

Why Choose This App?

This app combines accuracy with ease of use, making it the perfect tool for anyone dealing with construction materials. Whether you are identifying blocks for renovation, exploring material options for design, or simply satisfying curiosity, it provides valuable insights at your fingertips.

Get Started Today

Download now and experience the quickest way to identify construction materials with AI. Save time, reduce mistakes, and bring confidence to your projects.

Always consult a qualified expert before making construction or renovation decisions.
